Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms carefully before using Chitkara Carpool.

Last updated: August 2026

1. Using Chitkara Carpool

Chitkara Carpool helps Chitkara University students coordinate shared travel. By using this platform, you agree to use it responsibly and only for legitimate carpooling purposes.

2. Account Information

You are responsible for providing accurate information when creating and using your account. Keep your login information secure and do not share your account with another person.

3. Ride Requests

Ride details such as pickup location, destination, date, time, available seats and price should be entered honestly. A ride request does not guarantee acceptance until the driver confirms it.

4. Drivers and Passengers

Drivers and passengers are expected to communicate respectfully and follow applicable university, traffic and safety rules. Users should verify ride details before travelling.

5. Safety

Always use reasonable safety precautions. Do not share sensitive personal information unnecessarily. If a situation feels unsafe, do not proceed with the ride and seek appropriate assistance.

6. Cancellations

Users should cancel ride requests as early as possible when they can no longer travel. Repeated misuse of the platform may affect access to carpool features.

7. Respectful Conduct

Harassment, abusive behaviour, misleading ride information and misuse of the platform are not permitted. Users should treat other students respectfully.

8. Platform Responsibility

Chitkara Carpool is a coordination platform. Users are responsible for their own travel decisions and interactions. Always exercise appropriate judgement when arranging or joining a ride.

9. Changes to These Terms

These terms may be updated when features or platform policies change. Continued use of the platform after an update indicates acceptance of the revised terms.
